articles.title: Rahul Gandhi’s ‘Chhatron Ki Goonj’ vs PM Modi’s BJP Team Meet | Pune & Delhi Buzz | News18
articles.description: A busy political day unfolds with Rahul Gandhi’s “Chhatron Ki Goonj” student outreach programme in Pune and Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s first interaction with the BJP’s newly appointed national office-bearers in Delhi.Rahul Gandhi reached Pune on August 22 for the women-focused edition of “Chhatron Ki Goonj”, part of Congress’s wider student outreach campaign. The programme focused on engaging young women and hearing their concerns, with education, equality and social issues among the themes discussed. The event also came amid tensions between ABVP and NSUI members outside COEP University, adding a political edge to Rahul Gandhi’s visit.In Delhi, BJP president Nitin Nabin chaired his first meeting with the party’s newly appointed 65-member national team, with discussions centred on organisational strengthening, grassroots outreach and preparations for upcoming Assembly elections. The new team has 51 new faces, marking the BJP’s biggest organisational reshuffle in more than a decade.Prime Minister Narendra Modi later met the new BJP team at party headquarters and posed for a group photograph with the newly appointed office-bearers. articles.title: Hyderabad Building Collapse: 7-Storey Structure Crashes in Anjaiah Nagar, 1 Dead | News18
articles.description: A seven-storey building collapsed in Anjaiah Nagar, Madhapur, Hyderabad, triggering a major rescue operation and raising fresh questions over construction safety and building regulations.The latest reports confirm that one person died and two others were injured after the structure collapsed on Saturday. A large portion of the debris reportedly fell onto a neighbouring apartment, while people at a nearby hostel rushed out after the sudden collapse. Rescue teams searched through the rubble to check whether anyone else could be trapped.Questions are now being raised over the construction itself. Reports and local accounts allege that the structure was being built on an unusually small plot close to a nala, with possible violations of building regulations under scrutiny. However, the exact cause of the collapse and responsibility for any alleged violations remain subject to investigation.The incident has renewed concerns about illegal construction, structural safety, building permissions and enforcement in densely populated parts of Hyderabad. -newsCNN-News18 is your trusted source for breaking news, updates, and in-depth analysis from around the world. articles.title: In the 1950s, U.S. nuclear tests were conducted at Bikini and Enewetak; decades later, Guam corals preserved carbon-14 spikes linked to tests in 1954, 1956, and 1958
articles.description: Guam’s coral reefs act as natural historians, chronicling chemical footprints of Cold War-era nuclear tests. Distinct radiocarbon spikes from the years 1954, 1956, and 1958 reveal the pathways of nuclear fallout as it spread through the tropical Pacific. This invaluable information extracted from coral cores charts a sixty-year timeline of the ocean’s chemical changes, enabling scientists to accurately date marine species currently inhabiting these waters.
